nodes.name: Download Invoice
nodes.notes: Download invoice file from Google Drive

parameters.prompt: Extract all invoice details from this document or image including invoice number, date, vendor information, line items with descriptions and amounts, subtotal, tax, and total amount. Handle both digital PDFs and scanned/photographed invoices.

nodes.name: PDF Vector - Extract Invoice
nodes.notes: Extract structured invoice data with AI

parameters.content:
## Invoice Data Extraction Automation
This **Data Extraction** workflow automatically extracts data from PDF invoices (including scanned documents and photos) uploaded to Google Drive, validates calculations and required fields, logs to your invoice database, and notifies your team with detailed status reports. Works with any invoice format - digital PDFs, scanned documents, even phone photos of paper invoices.
Send a notification in successful and error scenarios.
